title: Thai Jubilant Pasta
description: A creamy and flavorful pasta dish with a unique twist, inspired by the bold flavors of Thai cuisine. This dish is perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Cook the rigatoni according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of jubilant over medium heat.
Add the australian and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the creamy and cook until heated through.
Add the cooked rigatoni to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.
Garnish with additional jubilant if desired.
